b1-29-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Why They Left
b1-29-01.scenario: Petra asks Meg why so many families left the country in the past. You (Meg) say that because of the war many families chose emigration.
b1-29-01.prompt: Tell Petra why many families left the country.
cues: Say what the reason was
Say what the families chose
b1-29-01.target: A háború miatt sok család választotta a kivándorlást.
b1-29-01.english: Because of the war many families chose emigration.
b1-29-01.canDo: I can say why people leave, with miatt and következtében.

b1-29-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The New Family
b1-29-02.scenario: Károly asks Meg where the new family settled and how the children are doing. You (Meg) say that the family settled in Budapest and that the children quickly adapted to the local customs.
b1-29-02.prompt: Tell Károly where the family settled and how the children are doing.
cues: Say where the family settled
Say how the children adapted
b1-29-02.target: A család Budapesten telepedett le. A gyerekek gyorsan alkalmazkodtak a helyi szokásokhoz.
b1-29-02.english: The family settled in Budapest. The children quickly adapted to the local customs.
b1-29-02.canDo: I can say where people settle and how they adapt, with letelepedik and alkalmazkodik vmihez.

b1-29-03.title: Communicative Challenge: An Old Neighbour
b1-29-03.scenario: Petra asks Meg about an old neighbour who lives far from his village. You (Meg) say that he lives far away but is always attached to his homeland.
b1-29-03.prompt: Tell Petra how your old neighbour feels about his homeland.
cues: Say that he lives far away
Say what he is attached to
b1-29-03.target: Messze él, de a szülőföldjéhez mindig kötődik.
b1-29-03.english: He lives far away, but he is always attached to his homeland.
b1-29-03.canDo: I can say where I belong and what I am attached to, with tartozik and kötődik vmihez.

b1-29-04.title: Communicative Challenge: A New Colleague
b1-29-04.scenario: Petra asks Meg about a new colleague. You (Meg) say that his family comes from an old Hungarian family and that his mother tongue is Hungarian.
b1-29-04.prompt: Tell Petra where your colleague's family comes from and what his mother tongue is.
cues: Say where his family comes from
Say what his mother tongue is
b1-29-04.target: A családja egy régi magyar családból származik. Az anyanyelve magyar.
b1-29-04.english: His family comes from an old Hungarian family. His mother tongue is Hungarian.
b1-29-04.canDo: I can say where my family comes from, with származik vhonnan.

b1-29-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Feeling at Home
b1-29-05.scenario: Petra asks Meg how the new family feels in the town. You (Meg) say that after the welcome the family feels at home.
b1-29-05.prompt: Tell Petra how the family feels after the welcome.
cues: Say what happened first
Say how the family feels now
b1-29-05.target: A család a befogadás után otthon érzi magát.
b1-29-05.english: After the welcome the family feels at home.
b1-29-05.canDo: I can say that someone feels at home, with otthon érzi magát.

b1-29-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Márai Far from Home
b1-29-consolidation.scenario: Petra asks Meg what the story about Márai is about. You (Meg) say that Márai lived far from his homeland but always wrote in Hungarian.
b1-29-consolidation.prompt: Tell Petra how Márai lived and which language he wrote in.
cues: Say where Márai lived
Say which language he always wrote in
b1-29-consolidation.target: Márai messze élt, de mindig magyarul írt.
b1-29-consolidation.english: Márai lived far away, but he always wrote in Hungarian.
b1-29-consolidation.canDo: I can retell a short story about a writer who leaves home and keeps his mother tongue, in a few sentences.

b1-30-01.title: Communicative Challenge: A Good Friend
b1-30-01.scenario: Petra asks Meg what a good friend is like. You (Meg) say that a good friend is a person who respects other people's culture.
b1-30-01.prompt: Tell Petra what kind of person a good friend is.
cues: Say who a good friend is
Say what he or she respects
b1-30-01.target: Jó barát az az ember, aki tiszteli mások kultúráját.
b1-30-01.english: A good friend is a person who respects other people's culture.
b1-30-01.canDo: I can describe a person or a thing with a chain of relative clauses, with aki, ami and amely.

b1-30-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Novel
b1-30-02.scenario: Károly asks Meg what she thought of the novel she read. You (Meg) say that it was an unforgettable experience.
b1-30-02.prompt: Tell Károly what you thought of the novel.
cues: Say which book you mean
Say that it was unforgettable
b1-30-02.target: Ez a regény felejthetetlen élmény volt.
b1-30-02.english: This novel was an unforgettable experience.
b1-30-02.canDo: I can describe something with adjectives in -hatatlan/-hetetlen, like felejthetetlen.

b1-30-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Old Folk Songs
b1-30-03.scenario: Petra asks Meg how the old folk songs survived. You (Meg) say that the folk songs passed from generation to generation.
b1-30-03.prompt: Tell Petra how the folk songs survived.
cues: Say what passed on
Say how they passed on
b1-30-03.english: The folk songs passed from generation to generation.
b1-30-03.canDo: I can say that customs pass from one generation to the next, with nemzedékről nemzedékre.

b1-30-04.title: Communicative Challenge: A Special Holiday
b1-30-04.scenario: Károly asks Meg what is special in Hungary. You (Meg) say that, in contrast to other peoples, the name day is important here.
b1-30-04.prompt: Tell Károly what is different here.
cues: Say what you contrast with
Say what is important here
b1-30-04.target: Ellentétben más népekkel, nálunk fontos a névnap.
b1-30-04.english: In contrast to other peoples, the name day is important with us.
b1-30-04.canDo: I can contrast cultures, with ellentétben and eltérően.

b1-30-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Translator
b1-30-05.scenario: Petra asks Meg what a literary translator does. You (Meg) say that a translator forms a bridge between two languages.
b1-30-05.prompt: Tell Petra what a translator does.
cues: Say who forms the bridge
Say between what
b1-30-05.target: A műfordító hidat képez két nyelv között.
b1-30-05.english: A translator forms a bridge between two languages.
b1-30-05.canDo: I can say how culture is shared, with hidat képez and hozzáférhetővé tesz.

b1-30-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Old Teacher
b1-30-consolidation.scenario: Petra asks Meg what the story about Abigél is about. You (Meg) say that the old teacher helps the girls and that Gina loves him.
b1-30-consolidation.prompt: Tell Petra what the teacher does and how Gina feels.
cues: Say whom the teacher helps
Say how Gina feels about him
b1-30-consolidation.target: A tanár úr segít a lányoknak. Gina szereti őt.
b1-30-consolidation.english: The teacher helps the girls. Gina loves him.
b1-30-consolidation.canDo: I can retell a short story about a girl in a strict school and a teacher who helps her, in a few sentences.

b1-32-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Plan Is Clear
b1-32-01.scenario: Petra asks Meg whether the team can decide today. You (Meg) say that the facts are clear, so you have to decide, and that the plan is also cheap.
b1-32-01.prompt: Tell Petra what follows from the facts and add one more argument for the plan.
cues: Say that the facts are clear and what follows from that
Add one more argument for the plan
b1-32-01.target: A tények világosak, tehát döntenünk kell. A terv ráadásul olcsó.
b1-32-01.english: The facts are clear, so we have to decide. The plan is also cheap, on top of that.
b1-32-01.canDo: I can draw a conclusion with tehát, ennélfogva and következésképpen.

b1-32-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Opening the Meeting
b1-32-02.scenario: Károly asks Meg to open the meeting. You (Meg) say that first of all you have to clarify the concepts and that, as far as the decision is concerned, everyone agrees.
b1-32-02.prompt: Open the meeting: say what comes first and what everyone thinks about the decision.
cues: Say what you have to do first
Say what everyone thinks about the decision
b1-32-02.target: Mindenekelőtt tisztáznunk kell a fogalmakat. Ami a döntést illeti, mindenki egyetért.
b1-32-02.english: First of all, we must clarify the concepts. As far as the decision is concerned, everyone agrees.
b1-32-02.canDo: I can open a point with mindenekelőtt and ami a … illeti.

b1-32-03.title: Communicative Challenge: A Good Idea, a Hard Practice
b1-32-03.scenario: Petra asks Meg what she thinks of the new plan. You (Meg) say that the idea is good, but that in practice there are many difficulties; still, there is hope.
b1-32-03.prompt: Tell Petra what is good about the plan and what is hard in practice.
cues: Say that the idea is good
Contrast it with the practice
Say that there is still hope
b1-32-03.target: Az ötlet jó, a gyakorlatban azonban sok a nehézség. Mindazonáltal van remény.
b1-32-03.english: The idea is good, but in practice there are many difficulties. Nevertheless, there is hope.
b1-32-03.canDo: I can contrast two ideas with azonban, viszont and mindazonáltal.

b1-32-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Time Is Pressing
b1-32-04.scenario: Károly asks Meg why the team decides today. You (Meg) say that since time is pressing, you have to decide immediately.
b1-32-04.prompt: Tell Károly why the team has to decide immediately.
cues: Give the reason
Say what the team must do
b1-32-04.target: Mivel az idő sürget, azonnal döntenünk kell.
b1-32-04.english: Since time is pressing, we have to decide immediately.
b1-32-04.canDo: I can give a reason with mivel and tekintettel arra, hogy.

b1-32-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Two Plans
b1-32-05.scenario: Petra asks Meg which of the two plans she prefers. You (Meg) say that the former is expensive and the latter is cheap, so you choose the latter.
b1-32-05.prompt: Tell Petra how the two plans differ and which one you choose.
cues: Say what the first plan is like
Say what the second plan is like
Say which one you choose
b1-32-05.target: Az előbbi terv drága, az utóbbi olcsó. Mindezek alapján az utóbbit választom.
b1-32-05.english: The former plan is expensive, the latter is cheap. On the basis of all this I choose the latter.
b1-32-05.canDo: I can refer back to two things with az előbbi and az utóbbi.

b1-32-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Timár on the Island
b1-32-consolidation.scenario: Károly asks Meg why Timár Mihály stays on the island at the end of Jókai's story. You (Meg) say that he stays on Senki Island and that he is happy there beside Noémi.
b1-32-consolidation.prompt: Tell Károly where Timár Mihály stays and how he feels there.
cues: Say where Timár stays
Say who he is with and how he feels there
b1-32-consolidation.target: Timár Mihály a Senki szigetén marad. Ott Noémi mellett boldog.
b1-32-consolidation.english: Timár Mihály stays on Senki Island. There he is happy beside Noémi.
b1-32-consolidation.canDo: I can retell in a few sentences why Timár Mihály stays on Senki Island at the end of Az arany ember.

b1-33-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Where Is Petra?
b1-33-01.scenario: Károly asks Meg where Petra is. You (Meg) say that Petra told you she is ill and that she will work the next day.
cues: Say what Petra said about how she is
Say what she said about the next day
b1-33-01.target: Petra azt mondta, hogy beteg. Azt mondta, hogy másnap dolgozik.
b1-33-01.english: Petra said that she is ill. She said that she would work the next day.
b1-33-01.canDo: I can report what someone said with azt mondta, hogy ….

b1-33-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Spokesperson
b1-33-02.scenario: Petra asks Meg what the spokesperson said about the new program. You (Meg) say that he announced a new program and stressed that the situation is stable.
b1-33-02.prompt: Tell Petra what the spokesperson announced and stressed.
cues: Say what he announced
Say what he emphasized
b1-33-02.target: A szóvivő bejelentette, hogy új program indul. Hangsúlyozta, hogy a helyzet stabil.
b1-33-02.english: The spokesperson announced that a new program is starting. He emphasized that the situation is stable.
b1-33-02.canDo: I can report an official statement with bejelentette, hogy … and hangsúlyozta, hogy ….

b1-33-03.title: Communicative Challenge: At the Reception
b1-33-03.scenario: Károly asks Meg what the guest asked at the reception. You (Meg) say that he asked whether the office is still open and when the train arrives.
b1-33-03.prompt: Tell Károly what the guest asked.
cues: Say what he asked about the office
Say what he asked about the train
b1-33-03.target: Azt kérdezte, hogy nyitva van-e még az iroda. Érdeklődött, hogy mikor érkezik meg a vonat.
b1-33-03.english: He asked whether the office is still open. He inquired when the train arrives.
b1-33-03.canDo: I can report a yes/no question with hogy … -e.

b1-33-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Doctor's Advice
b1-33-04.scenario: Petra asks Meg what the doctor said. You (Meg) say that the doctor told the patient to rest a lot.
b1-33-04.prompt: Tell Petra what the doctor told the patient.
cues: Say who gave the instruction
Say what the patient has to do
b1-33-04.target: Az orvos arra utasította a beteget, hogy pihenjen sokat.
b1-33-04.english: The doctor instructed the patient to rest a lot.
b1-33-04.canDo: I can report a command with hogy and -jon/-jen.

b1-33-05.title: Communicative Challenge: News From the Village
b1-33-05.scenario: Károly asks Meg what people say about the village and its old manor. You (Meg) say that allegedly a miracle happened in the village and that rumor has it that a great fortune is hidden in the old manor.
b1-33-05.prompt: Tell Károly what people say about the village and the manor.
cues: Say what allegedly happened in the village
Say what the rumor about the manor is
b1-33-05.target: Állítólag csoda történt a faluban. Úgy hírlik, hogy nagy vagyon rejtőzik a régi kastélyban.
b1-33-05.english: Allegedly a miracle happened in the village. Rumor has it that a great fortune is hidden in the old manor.
b1-33-05.canDo: I can mark a rumour with állítólag and úgy hírlik, hogy ….

b1-33-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Veronka and the Umbrella
b1-33-consolidation.scenario: Petra asks Meg what happened to little Veronka in the rain in Mikszáth's story. You (Meg) say that Veronka stayed dry and that a big red umbrella was over her basket.
b1-33-consolidation.prompt: Tell Petra what happened to Veronka in the rain.
cues: Say how Veronka was in the rain
Say what was over her basket
b1-33-consolidation.target: Veronka száraz maradt az esőben. Egy nagy piros esernyő volt a kosara fölött.
b1-33-consolidation.english: Veronka stayed dry in the rain. A big red umbrella was over her basket.
b1-33-consolidation.canDo: I can retell in a few sentences how a red umbrella kept little Veronka dry in Szent Péter esernyője.
